convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'BreakoutBarsTrend_v2' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Entry/exit logic depends entirely on this custom indicator's buffer values. External .mqh (Trade.mqh) is standard library but the custom indicator requires separate implementation or porting.

derived_values.name: delta - validated Delta parameter
derived_values.formula: InpDelta if >=0, else 1000 (PIPS mode) or 1.0 (PERCENT mode)

derived_values.name: stopLoss - validated Stop Loss parameter
derived_values.formula: InpStopLoss if >=0, else 1000 (PIPS mode) or 1.0 (PERCENT mode)

derived_values.name: takeProfit - validated Take Profit parameter
derived_values.formula: InpTakeProfit if >=0, else 1000 (PIPS mode) or 1.0 (PERCENT mode)

derived_values.name: calculateDistance - SL/TP distance in price units
derived_values.used_by: SL and TP price calculation in checkForOpen

derived_values.name: stopLevel - minimum stop distance from broker
derived_values.used_by: SL/TP clamping to respect broker stop level

params.mode: PIPS or PERCENT depending on InpReversal
params.note: In PIPS mode: InpStopLoss * _Point from entry; In PERCENT mode: (price/100)*InpStopLoss from entry

params.mode: PIPS or PERCENT depending on InpReversal
params.note: In PIPS mode: InpTakeProfit * _Point from entry; In PERCENT mode: (price/100)*InpTakeProfit from entry

other_exits: Close position when BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 trend reverses against current position direction

params.volume_validation: Clamped to SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN/SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX, rounded to SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP

custom_logic_notes: Entry has a 'negative series' filter (InpNegatives): if negatives > 0, the EA only enters after checking isNegativeSeries() which verifies that the last N trend reversals were all losing (price moved against the trend). This acts as a consecutive-loss filter before re-entry. The BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 indicator buffer values are used to detect trend changes: when buffer[0] * buffer[1] < 0, a trend reversal occurred. The sign of buffer[1] determines direction (positive = uptrend, negative = downtrend). SL/TP are clamped to respect SYMBOL_TRADE_STOPS_LEVEL. The reversal mode (PIPS vs PERCENT) determines how Delta, SL, and TP are interpreted - they must all use the same mode.
python_conversion_notes: The BreakoutBarsTrend_v2 custom indicator must be ported to Python first - its buffer output (positive/negative values indicating trend direction) drives all entry and exit logic. The PIPS vs PERCENT mode affects how SL/TP distances are calculated (multiply by Point vs percentage of price). The negative series filter (isNegativeSeries) iterates backward through indicator reversal points checking if consecutive trends were losers - this is a unique filter that must be faithfully reproduced. The new-bar guard uses datetime comparison of current bar time vs static prevTime, allowing only one signal per bar. Position check uses PositionSelect(_Symbol) - single position per symbol. Volume normalization uses broker min/max/step values.
